<thought>To obtain a valid template ID, we need to search for a forward reaction that breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl group and a trimethylsilyl group and forms a C‑C double bond (the Peterson elimination). Using the available functional‑group names, we search with functional_groups_broken = ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "trimethylsilyl"] and functional_groups_formed = ["C-C double bonds"] for the target alkene COc1ccc(cc1)C=C(Cc2ccc(OC)cc2). This should return a template that can be used retrosynthetically.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccc(cc1)C=C(Cc2ccc(OC)cc2)",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"]
}</action_input>
